title: CloudFront and Global Accelerator side by side
claim: CloudFront answers HTTP requests from edge caches, and Global Accelerator carries TCP and UDP from two static addresses to endpoints in Regions.
alt: Two panels. Left, CloudFront: users reach an edge location with cached copies; a miss goes to the origin. Right, Global Accelerator: users reach two static anycast addresses; traffic crosses the AWS global network to load balancers in two Regions.
